method: Fetch the remote branch into a new empty bare partial repository, retrieve every file listed in backup-scope.json from that commit and compare byte sizes and SHA256. No original local Git object cache used by the verification repository.
checks: Both original PNGs decode and match supplied bytes/hashes
Proposed test and unknown metrics retain explicit unset status
scope_note: Backup verification does not establish CTR improvement, audience preference, replacement approval or a completed thumbnail test. The subsequent receipt commit is checked against the remote separately after push.
